long_biography.plain_text:
Francisca Cortés Solari developed a Chilean philanthropic programme that couples education with scientific conservation. Its beginnings were Color Esperanza, an experiential education project for adolescents. She later established Fundación Caserta and Fundación MERI, extending the work into ecological research and learning across Chile's desert, central region and northern Patagonia.

Before concentrating on the foundations, Cortés Solari studied fashion design and worked in her family's retail business, managing stores and creating clothing collections. Her conservation teams have studied cetaceans in northern Patagonia and helped develop acoustic monitoring intended to reduce collisions with whales. The protected areas maintained by her organisations serve as field sites where scientists, educators and communities can work together.
long_biography.html:
Francisca Cortés Solari developed a Chilean philanthropic programme that couples education with scientific conservation. Its beginnings were Color Esperanza, an experiential education project for adolescents. She later established Fundación Caserta and Fundación MERI, extending the work into ecological research and learning across Chile's desert, central region and northern Patagonia.

Before concentrating on the foundations, Cortés Solari studied fashion design and worked in her family's retail business, managing stores and creating clothing collections. Her conservation teams have studied cetaceans in northern Patagonia and helped develop acoustic monitoring intended to reduce collisions with whales. The protected areas maintained by her organisations serve as field sites where scientists, educators and communities can work together.
